title: Song - Silent Night
subtitle: Arrangement: the tune with left-hand block chords
raisedBecause: A long tune in 6/8 whose dotted rhythms divide the beat into sixteenths.
trains: A lullaby in 6/8 over block chords (B flat, E flat, F) in the left, with dotted rhythms.

provenance.author: claude-sonnet-5
provenance.basedOn: mutopia-1295-stille-nacht: "Stille Nacht" (hymn tune, "Silent Night"), F. X. Gruber, SATB; the tune is in the Soprano (https://www.mutopiaproject.org/cgibin/piece-info.cgi?id=1295)
provenance.note: Melody from www.cyberhymnal.org (https://www.mutopiaproject.org/cgibin/piece-info.cgi?id=1295), public domain; left-hand chords our own (CC0)

departures: Left-hand block chords are our own (CC0).
